title: Fix your iniBuilds Tristar: get 40+ liveries NOW! (MSFS 2024)
description:
STOP flying with just the default paint! If you just bought the iniBuilds L1011-500 Tristar from the MSFS 2024 Marketplace, you might be shocked to find only one livery in your hangar. Don't worry—you aren't missing anything; you just need to unlock the other 40+ liveries manually.

In this tutorial, I show you the secret fix to getting your iniBuilds aircraft looking spectacular. We’ll walk through the iniManager configuration, specifically how to correctly set your Sim Path so the tool recognizes your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 installation. Whether you want to fly the classic TWA, Delta, or the Royal Air Force (RAF) schemes, this guide covers the installation and the "restart trick" to ensure they show up in your library.
